name: zsnd_wave_data_load_and_parse_from_index_archive_if_needed
description: zSndWaveData::LoadAndParseFromIndexArchiveIfNeeded loads a named WAV payload from a zIndexArchive and parses it once.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 /MD byte verification for 0x4a5600 passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking; relocation bytes masked: 16.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4a5600 validates that already parsed data returns 1; otherwise it queries zIndexArchive::ReadFileByName for the named file size, stores fileSize, allocates fileData when the size is positive, reads the archive payload into fileData, calls ParseLoadedWaveFile, stores parsedOk, and returns parsedOk.

The native archive smoke verifies zIndexArchive size query and payload read, then loads and parses a PCM RIFF payload through LoadAndParseFromIndexArchiveIfNeeded, checking parsedOk, fileSize, fmt, pcmData, and pcmByteCount.
The native edge smoke verifies missing archive entry handling and already-parsed early return.
